accepted_scope: Original formal scalar algebraic unit-group problem and faithful matrix-valued multiplicative S-type transform on distributions with invertible means.

advisory_findings.summary: The equality [U_2,U_2]=F^3 in Friedrich--McKay Example 6.1 is false by projection to an abelian one-variable boxed group.

scope_guardrails: Commutative coefficient rings; ring means must be units, not merely nonzero.
Characteristic zero is used for logarithms and BCH, not inverse or representation constructions.
Faithfulness is on formal distributions, not raw tuples.
No minimality, unique preferred representation, analytic domain, or full-center classification is certified.
The one-variable classical S-series is recoverable; the regular matrices do not literally equal it.
The cited preprints are not endorsed wholesale.
No novelty, first-resolution, or exhaustive-priority claim.
review_type: Independent AI-assisted adversarial mathematical audit; not peer review.
